sourceIssues.reason: RO draft omitted the friend relationship in birthday-party gloss; corrected before completion.
English says ㄹ-stems drop l before future ending. Canonical 만들 거예요/놀 거예요 retain stem ㄹ and do not add a second ㄹ. Native draft describes no additional l; source-author grammar correction required.
메시지 남겨 드릴까요? literally offers to leave a message, whereas English says take a message. Native follows leave on your behalf; telephone-context role needs source author confirmation.
Korean 먹을래요 expresses wish/choice; native uses want to eat out rather than merely a fixed future.
Korean umbrella holder has no explicit gender. English He is not used as gender evidence.
Korean bag owner and departing subject are omitted; English His/he gender removed.
Korean face owner/test taker omitted; English His/he gender removed.
ㅂ irregular and ㄹ deletion note is simplified; translation is authoring, no independent grammar approval.
The blanket rule cannot be used with requests is overbroad across sequential and causal uses; source author must scope it.
Reported-question embedded subject is omitted in Korean; English assigns I. Draft follows reference reading but subject cannot be independently fixed from isolated source.
Reported destination question omits embedded subject in Korean; draft I reading is reference-dependent.

Korean sentence omits asker; native preserves indefinite asker rather than reassigning 그 사람 as reporter.
